scope: Primary mall/brand sources for factual 1–2-sentence description rewrites. No copy, roster, language, current occupancy or publication approval inferred.
method: Web source reading/search, plus fresh HTTPS retrieval of first-party mall pages that the web reader could not access. Mall page descriptions and brand-wide product identity are distinguished from branch-specific inventory. Summaries below are paraphrases, not quotations.

records.evidenceSummary: The mall describes modern minimalist fashion collections. The brand's own introduction specializes its identity to women's officewear and elegant designs, and lists a Saigon Centre floor-3 store.
copyFacts: Women's officewear
Modern, restrained styling and elegant silhouettes
avoid: Unverified fabric composition or current product stock
Unsupported claims of European manufacturing
Repeating the brand's popularity/superlative marketing as independent fact
records.branchQualification: Mall and brand both list this branch; no in-person operating/stock verification.

records.evidenceSummary: The mall describes Qhome's ceramics/porcelain and tableware for household and professional use, distributing domestic and international names including Minh Long I, Cuong Phat, Wilmax, RAK and Noritake. This supports a table-setting/homeware introduction rather than a generic decoration-store description.
copyFacts: Ceramic and porcelain tableware
Vietnamese and international tableware brands for home and professional use
avoid: Inventing furniture, bedding or interior-design services
Promising all listed brands are in stock

records.evidenceSummary: Fresh mall description identifies Century as an Indonesian pharmacy-and-beauty retail chain with a wellness focus. A dated 2020 mall announcement explicitly calls its B2 outlet a pharmacy, but that historical notice is not fresh evidence of opening hours or current service breadth.
copyFacts: Health and beauty retailer with pharmacy roots
Wellness and skin-care focus
avoid: Inventing prescription dispensing, pharmacist consultation, clinical services or exact medicine range
Using the ended 2020 notice as current hours/occupancy proof
Medical efficacy or safety promises
records.branchQualification: Use the fresh mall listing for identity; historical pharmacy wording is explicitly dated.

records.evidenceSummary: The mall characterizes Dsquared2 by Canadian influence and Italian craftsmanship. The official brand storefront shows men's and women's fashion, including jeans, knitwear, outerwear, shoes and bags; denim is a concrete distinguishing product focus.
copyFacts: Men's and women's designer fashion with a denim focus
Bold styling combining Canadian influence and Italian craftsmanship
avoid: Claiming every product is manufactured in Italy
Claiming current Canadian flagship prices/ranges are available at this branch
records.branchQualification: Brand-wide offering evidence; branch stock not checked.

records.evidenceSummary: Mall copy mainly identifies the regional distributor. Lacoste's corporate history and polo feature support its tennis-derived fashion identity, signature petit-pique cotton polo and crocodile emblem; those details distinguish the introduction without inventing current branch collections.
copyFacts: Fashion rooted in tennis and everyday sports style
Signature cotton pique polo and crocodile emblem
avoid: Implying every garment is cotton pique
Branch-specific seasonal availability
Unverified claims about local sustainability practices
records.branchQualification: Brand history is stable identity evidence, not a local inventory check.

records.evidenceSummary: Fresh mall page lists RAK Thai as Food & Beverage at L5-12 with phone/hours, but supplies no menu or descriptive paragraph. Bounded first-party search did not establish dishes, service format or a matching independent restaurant-owned site.
copyFacts: Named F&B outlet in the official mall directory
avoid: Inferring tom yum, pad thai, hotpot or specific Thai regional cuisine from the name
Using another similarly named restaurant's menu
Inventing a detailed overall restaurant description
records.proposedTreatment: Keep detailed copy unsupported pending a matched first-party menu/introduction; do not fill with generic prose.

records.evidenceSummary: Fresh mall page identifies Sport Fair, but its descriptive body is only the letter S. No bounded first-party search result establishes a matching retailer offering or brand assortment.
copyFacts: Official mall directory identity only
avoid: Inventing sports equipment, footwear, apparel, outdoor goods or named brands from the store name
Treating letter S as a descriptive source
records.proposedTreatment: Keep offering copy unsupported until a matched first-party source or owner evidence is supplied.

records.evidenceSummary: Mall listing places Fujifilm in Electronics at L3-K8 but supplies no offering paragraph. Fujifilm Vietnam's official consumer portfolio covers digital photography, instax instant imaging and photo-printing solutions. This supports a brand introduction, without claiming all lines are sold at the mall kiosk.
copyFacts: Photography and imaging brand
Digital cameras, instax instant photography and photo-printing product families
avoid: Claiming kiosk printing services, camera repairs or every camera series is locally available
Using the unrelated healthcare/cosmetics business to describe this Electronics listing
records.branchQualification: Product families are brand-wide; kiosk-specific range requires evidence.

records.evidenceSummary: The mall lists PNJ under Jewelry & Watches at L2-32/32A. PNJ's official catalog supports gold, silver and gemstone jewelry, including rings, earrings, necklaces and wedding/engagement collections; those categories are stronger evidence than vague luxury or feng-shui claims.
copyFacts: Vietnamese jewelry brand offering gold, silver and gemstone designs
Everyday jewelry and wedding/engagement collections
avoid: Guaranteeing specific stones/karats or local stock
Inventing feng-shui benefits or investment promises
records.branchQualification: Catalog describes the brand, not confirmed stock of this branch.

records.evidenceSummary: Aesop's own story supports skin, hair and body-care formulations, developed using plant-based and laboratory-made ingredients. Fresh mall page marks the Saigon Centre entry Opening Soon, so a brand introduction must not imply the branch is already open or that consultations are currently available there.
copyFacts: Melbourne-based skin, hair and body-care brand
Formulations draw on both botanical and laboratory-made ingredients
avoid: Presenting this branch as open
Promising local consultation services, stock or opening date
Independent efficacy/safety claims based on brand marketing
records.branchQualification: Opening Soon must remain visible in publication treatment; no opening date verified.

records.evidenceSummary: Mall page identifies Dr Martens but has no descriptive paragraph. The official brand sole guide documents boots/shoes, grooved air-cushioned soles and signature yellow welt stitching across its classic ranges, supporting a distinctive footwear introduction.
copyFacts: Footwear brand associated with boots and shoes
Classic designs distinguished by grooved air-cushioned soles and yellow stitching
avoid: Claiming every model uses yellow stitching or identical construction
Promising current branch models, repairs or medical comfort benefits
records.branchQualification: Use wording about classic/recognizable designs rather than universal technical claims.
